It is a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=minor shrine listed in the Engishiki}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Amenohohinomikoto Shrine'''|天穂日命神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Inaba Province]].

== Overview ==
It is located to the west of the Fukui hamlet in Tottori City. The principal enshrined deity is {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amenohohi-no-Mikoto}}, who is said to have been the tutelary deity of the ancient {{ill|Inaba Province|Q1054338|qid=Q1054338}} {{ill|Gōzoku|ar|غوزوكو|fa|گوزوکو|ff|Gōzoku|fr|Gōzoku|it|Gōzoku|ja|豪族|pt|Gōzoku|vi|Gōzoku|zh|豪族 (日本)|qid=Q84066}}, the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Inaba no Kuni no Miyatsuko clan}}. Behind the shrine precincts, something believed to be a {{ill|Zenpō-kōen-fun|Q11268718|qid=Q11268718}} (keyhole-shaped burial mound) has been identified, suggesting a connection with the Inaba no Kuni no Miyatsuko clan. Nearby are {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amehinatori-no-Mikoto Shrine}}, which enshrines Amenohohi-no-Mikoto’s child {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amehinatori-no-Mikoto}}, and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Mikuma Shrine}}, which enshrines {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Mikuma-no-Mikoto}} (officially called “Atagatsutake Mikuma-no-Mikoto Shrine”).

== History ==
The date of foundation is unknown. According to the {{ill|Inaba-shi|ja|因幡志|qid=Q11420257}}, it was originally located at the present site of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Hiyoshi Shrine}} in Fuse, {{ill|Takakusa district|ja|高草郡|pl|Powiat Takakusa|zh|高草郡|qid=Q11672760}}. It was worshiped as the tutelary shrine of the ancient local ruling clan, the Inaba no Kuni no Miyatsuko, and grew alongside the expansion of that clan’s power. In the 9th year of {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} (May {{ill|867|ab|867|af|867|am|867 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|867|ar|867|ary|867|ast|867|avk|867|az|867|azb|۸۶۷ (میلادی)|bcl|867|be|867|be_x_old|867|bg|867|bn|৮৬৭|bpy|মারি ৮৬৭|br|867|bs|867.|ca|867|cdo|867 nièng|ceb|867|ckb|٨٦٧|crh|867|cs|867|csb|867|cv|867|cy|867|da|867|de|867|el|867|eml|867|eo|867|es|867|et|867|eu|867|fa|۸۶۷ (میلادی)|fi|867|fo|867|fr|867|frr|867|fy|867|ga|867|gan|867年|gd|867|gl|867|he|867|hi|867|hr|867.|ht|867 (almanak jilyen)|hu|867|hy|867|id|867|ilo|867|io|867|is|867|it|867|ja|867年|jv|867|ka|867|kaa|867|kk|867 жыл|ko|867년|la|867|lb|867|lij|867|lmo|867|lt|867 m.|lv|867. gads|map_bms|867|mdf|867|mg|867|mhr|867|mk|867|mr|इ.स. ८६७|mrj|867 и|ms|867|mzn|۸۶۷|nah|867|nap|867|nds|867|new|सन् ८६७|nl|867|nn|867|no|867|nrm|867|nso|867|oc|867|or|୮୬୭|os|867-æм аз|pl|867|pnb|867|pt|867|qu|867|ro|867|ru|867 год|rue|867|sa|८६७|scn|867|sd|867ع|se|867|sh|867.|shn|867|si|867|sk|867|sl|867|smn|867|sq|867|sr|867|su|867|sv|867|sw|867|tg|Соли 867|th|พ.ศ. 1410|tk|867|tl|867|tly|867|tr|867|tt|867 ел|uk|867|ur|867ء|uz|867|vec|867|vi|867|war|867|wuu|867年|xmf|867|zh|867年|zh_min_nan|867 nî|zh_yue|867年|qid=Q30347}}), it was granted the rank of {{ill|Senior Third Rank|ja|正三位|ko|정3위|zh|正三位|qid=Q11123261}} and was listed as an official shrine.
